subject: Competitive bake-off recap: Novanet — Redwood vs OmniHealth
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novanet.com>, David Chen <david.chen@novanet.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap: Novanet — Redwood vs OmniHealth

Hi Sarah / David,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for the bake-off: 

Summary of pains you called out
- High per-token cost at scale (esp. with 20k–40k daily queries)
- Inconsistent tail latency during peak business hours impacting user experience
- Need for strict data isolation and auditability for PHI-like records

Goals you listed
- Achieve <300ms median generation latency for single-turn prompts
- 30–40% reduction in per-token inference cost vs current setup
- SOC 2 + audit logs and customer-controlled KMS

What we demonstrated
- NVBench numbers for our quantized models (attached) that show consistent p50/p95 under realistic request patterns
- Smart routing and automatic fallback to cheaper model variants to keep tail latency low
- Private deployment options and per-token cost breakdown in Console

Decision criteria you mentioned
- Latency at p95 under load (primary)
- Cost per 1M tokens (secondary)
- Security/compliance posture (SOC2, KMS, segmentation)

Open questions we committed to answer
1) Provide a bake-off matrix mapping feature/metrics across Redwood / OmniHealth / Novanet in a single sheet (attached: bakeoff-matrix.xlsx).
2) Share the raw benchmark PDFs for our 8k/16k sequence runs (attached: redwood-benchmarks.pdf).
3) Confirm SOC2 scope and sample audit artifacts — will coordinate via Marissa.

Proposed next steps
- Rishi/Marissa to share the benchmark plan and test harness by EOD Monday (attached: benchmark-plan.docx).
- Novanet to confirm two representative workloads (a high-throughput low-latency path + a lower-throughput long-context path) by next Wednesday 10/28.
- Live side-by-side test: schedule a 60–90 min run where we execute the two workloads and collect p50/p95/p99 and cost metrics.

If that looks right, we'll draft a mutual action plan and lock the live test slot.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: bakeoff-matrix.xlsx, redwood-benchmarks.pdf

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novanet.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, David Chen <david.chen@novanet.com>
Cc: procurement@novanet.com
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 18:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap: Novanet — Redwood vs OmniHealth

Thanks Rishi — this is great, clear and actionable. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- Timeline: Procurement is aiming to finish vendor selection by the end of November. We'll need a short exec summary for the final committee.
- Workloads: We'll provide the two representative workloads you requested (expects: chat-like support flow with ~1k tokens/session and a long-context analysis job with ~12k tokens).
- Compliance: Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a SOC 2 Type II report and KMS integration documentation? Procurement will need that to kick off the review. I've attached our requirements doc for reference.

Also — two asks for the live test: 1) include token-level cost breakdown exported to CSV, and 2) capture KV cache hit/miss stats if possible. Those will be weighted in our decision criteria.

Appreciate it —

Sarah Lee
Senior Product Manager, Search & AI | Novanet
sarah.lee@novanet.com | +1 (617) 555-2098

Attachment: novanet-requirements.pdf

Benchmarks / Metrics

Proposed live test plan (high level)
- Wed 10/28 10:00–11:30 PT: side-by-side run (we'll run Redwood; Novanet can choose to run OmniHealth or supply their existing results).
- Deliverables: p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost CSV, KV cache metrics, and run logs; we'll provide a notebook summarizing methodology.

Action items I'll take now
- Share benchmark plan & test harness link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-bakeoff-plan
- Coordinate SOC2 artifacts with Marissa and send S3 link for procurement.
- Confirm slot with Marissa & DD availability and lock calendar.

If that works I'll get calendar invites out today.

Cheers,

Rishi
